answer: Proposal: auction influence, never grant it. Each epoch consensus mints U weight units and sells them at the U-th highest bid, burning payments; settlement is deterministic, no issuer. No weight is free per vertex and no per-account bonus exists, so the ledger builds no bridge from account count to payout: an ocean of fresh accounts gets spend-proportional share on terms identical to one wallet. Splitting, parallel machines, timing: zero change; bonds scale with bids, not accounts. Seams: money wins, not headcount; a lone deep pocket can buy a thin epoch.
